{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Lectures on the Nature of the Force''''' was a compilation of lectures made by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]] on the nature of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was published by the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and released to the public. [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] quoted from the ''Lectures'' in their own paper entitled "[[Life's Memories (Herrera and Reston)|''Life's Memories'']]."
